a: `mergeRegion` throws when a long straight edge has a short, slightly tilted one lying along it
`pathFromD` ignores numbers after `Z` and keeps drawing, where SVG stops at the error
`simplifyAnchorsAt` deletes every anchor of a closed one-anchor subpath and leaves an empty subpath in the set
`simplifyPath` drops lone-anchor subpaths, though its doc says open ends stay
`roughenPath` gives two contours the same offsets once a contour has more than 65,536 samples
b: Marker builders write absolute float32 coords with no origin, so a marker far from 0 loses its shape
reachToMeet with an explicit `maxDistance: Infinity` in tangent or eased mode meets nothing
pathSignedArea returns a negative area for a RectPath with negative extent, contradicting "counts as positive"
